datasets.description: Rwanda Near Term Projection FEWS NET Acute Food Insecurity Classifications Geographic data for 2021. [Source: This metadata record was automatically extracted from the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX); Original dataset: https://data.humdata.org/dataset/rwanda_near_term_projection__fewsnet_ipc_shapefile_for_2021]
datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators conducted regular (typically monthly) field surveys across Rwanda to classify acute food insecurity conditions using the IPC framework. Geographic data with IPC phase classifications and scenario projections were compiled for each month of 2021 to provide near-term food security outlook.
